sections.Profile:
This single-player electro-mechanical game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, nine standup targets, two kick-out holes, a rollover button, a right-side drop lane with a ball return gate, and an up-post between the flippers.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Backbox Gimmick, Magic, Original Theme, 1970s
